title: BACS mandate status change.
description: Bankers' Automated Clearing System (BACS) mandate event data. BACS is a UK service that facilitates electronic money transfers between banks within a 3-day settlement cycle — day 1 (submission), day 2 (processing), and day 3 (clearing). This event represents a BACS Direct Debit mandate request received from the scheme. It is emitted when a mandate transitions between lifecycle states such as `CREATED`, `CONFIRMED`, `CANCELLED`, or `FAILED`.

id.title: ID
id.description: Pismo mandate ID. Use this ID to fetch or reference the mandate in Pismo BACS mandate APIs. To cross-reference the mandate at the provider, use `external_id`.

external_id.title: External ID
external_id.description: Provider (Form3) mandate ID. You can use this to link the mandate in our system to the provider's mandate. Might be absent in case of provider timeout

org_id.title: Org ID
org_id.description: Organization ID that owns the mandate

role.title: Role
role.description: Account role in the mandate. Always `PAYER` — the account is the debtor being debited under the mandate.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: Client reference for the mandate that you can use for reconciliation or debugging purposes

status_reason.description: Reason associated with the mandate status, typically populated when a mandate is `FAILED` or `CANCELLED`.

description.title: Description
description.description: Human-readable reason for the mandate status

code.title: Code
code.description: Reason code. Form3 error codes (`EBACSxxxx`) or BACS mandate return reason codes (`ADDACS`, `AUDDIS`, `DUPL`).
